name: medusajs-payload-boilerplate
description: A boilerplate for Medusa.js 2.0 with Payload CMS v3 integration

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && pnpm dev" "cd cms && pnpm dev"
scripts.build: concurrently "cd backend && pnpm build" "cd cms && pnpm build"
scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && pnpm start" "cd cms && pnpm start"
scripts.test: concurrently "cd backend && pnpm test" "cd cms && pnpm test"
scripts.lint: concurrently "cd backend && pnpm lint" "cd cms && pnpm lint"
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules && cd backend && rimraf node_modules && cd ../cms && rimraf node_modules
